description: One CT scan: links source and detector and holds the resolved geometry per projection, so reconstruction needs no TF lookup. Geometry is in the world frame, lengths in m.

source.description: Node path of the source, e.g. sensors/source_0.

detector.description: Node path of the detector, e.g. sensors/detector_0.

trajectory.description: Name or parameters of the planned trajectory.

scan_poses.description: raybotic_scan_pose_interfaces/ScanPose: roi in the world, source and detector in the roi frame. Poses as px, py, pz, qx, qy, qz, qw.

projections.description: One row per projection; time = exposure time.

image_index.description: Sample index in the detector's image series.

detector_position.description: Centre of the image (between pixels width/2-0.5 and height/2-0.5).

detector_u.description: Unit vector along increasing column index.

detector_v.description: Unit vector along increasing row index.

flags.description: Bit 0 invalid, bit 1 geometry interpolated, bit 2 robot unreachable, bit 3 emission unstable.
